title: Homework Download Nahi Hua
text:
Teacher: Tumhara homework kahan hai?
Pappu: Ma'am, Wi-Fi band tha. Homework download hi nahi hua.

title: Class Mein Shaanti
text:
Teacher: Sabse achhi neend kahan aati hai?
Pappu: Aapki class mein, ma'am. Wahan bahut shaanti hoti hai.

title: Sapne Dekho
text:
Teacher: Tum class mein so kyun rahe the?
Student: Ma'am, aapne hi toh kaha tha, "Sapne dekho, tabhi poore honge."

title: Newton Ka Teesra Niyam
text:
Teacher: Newton ka teesra niyam batao.
Student: Sir, jab mummy daant'ti hain, toh equal and opposite reaction papa ki taraf se aata hai.

title: Gol Earth
text:
Teacher: Earth gol kyun hai?
Pappu: Taaki punishment mein koi kone mein khada na ho sake, ma'am.

title: Jo Aata Hai Likho
text:
Teacher: Tumne test mein sirf apna naam kyun likha?
Pappu: Ma'am, aapne kaha tha, "Jo aata hai, woh likho."

title: Aadhi Fees
text:
Patient: Doctor, main raat ko phone chalata hun, isliye neend nahi aati.
Doctor: Phone band kar do aur so jao.
Patient: Bas itna? Toh fees bhi aadhi kar do.

title: Tension Ki Wajah
text:
Doctor: Aapko itni tension kyun hai?
Patient: Doctor sahab, aapki fees sunke.

title: Fridge Tak Walk
text:
Doctor: Roz 30 minute walk kiya karo.
Patient: Doctor sahab, main roz fridge tak 20 baar jaata hun. Chalega?

title: Kuch Bhi Chalega
text:
Wife: Aaj dinner mein kya banaun?
Husband: Kuch bhi chalega.
Wife: Theek hai, khichdi bana di.
Husband: Kuch bhi ka matlab khichdi thodi tha!

title: Boss Ki Boss
text:
Husband: Is ghar ka boss main hun.
Wife: Bilkul. Aur main boss ki boss.

title: Confused Calendar
text:
Wife: Tum mera birthday kaise bhool gaye?
Husband: Tum har saal itni young lagti ho ki calendar bhi confuse ho jaata hai.

title: Raat Bhar Ka Topper
text: Dost ki definition: exam se ek raat pehle bolega, "Bhai, maine bhi kuch nahi padha", aur phir 90% le aayega.

title: Udhaar Ka Hisaab
text:
Dost: Bhai, 500 rupaye udhaar de.
Main: Abhi sirf 200 hain.
Dost: Chal, 200 de de. Baaki 300 tu mujhe baad mein de dena.

title: Khaane Par Haq
text: Hum itne achhe dost hain ki ek dusre ke tiffin par pehla haq samajhte hain.

title: IPL Auction
text: Relatives ka favourite sawaal: "Beta, placement kab hoga?" Jaise main college mein nahi, IPL auction mein hun.

title: Mom GPS
text: Indian mom ka GPS: tum kitne bhi door ho, "Khana khaya?" ka signal hamesha full aata hai.

title: Traffic Rule
text: Desi traffic rule: horn bajao. Light green ho, red ho, ya bas mood kharab ho.

title: Bas 10 Minute AC
text: Indian papa jab AC on karte hain: "Bas 10 minute chalao, phir fan kar dena."

title: Do Not Disturb
text:
Boss: Weekend pe thoda kaam kar loge?
Employee: Sir, weekend pe toh mera phone bhi Do Not Disturb pe hota hai. Main toh insaan hun.

title: Monday Meeting
text: Monday meeting: 1 ghanta meeting, 5 minute ka kaam, aur 55 minute "Aap mute pe ho."

title: Salary Aur EMI
text: Salary ek din ke mehmaan ki tarah aati hai, aur EMI ghar ke permanent member ki tarah rehti hai.

title: Team Player
text:
Resume: "Excellent team player."
Reality: team lunch mein sabse pehle pahunchta hai.

title: Confidence 100%
text:
Syllabus: 20 chapters.
Maine padhe: 2 chapters.
Mera confidence: 100%.

title: Pehle BP Check
text:
Papa: Result mein kitne marks aaye?
Main: Papa, pehle aap apna BP check kar lo.

title: Personal Dushman
text: Question paper dekhke laga ki paper setter mera personal dushman hai.

title: Safai Wala Exam
text: Padhne baitha toh yaad aaya table saaf karni hai. Phir room. Phir poora ghar. Exam ne mujhe safai karna sikha diya.

title: Knowledge Loading
text: College life: attendance 60%, canteen 100%, knowledge "loading..."

title: Proxy Kisne Lagayi
text:
Professor: Proxy kisne lagayi?
Poori class: Sir, jisne lagayi woh aaj aaya hi nahi.

title: Namaste Zyada Khushi Se
text:
Chintu: Mummy, mehmaan aayein toh kya bolna hai?
Mummy: Namaste.
Chintu: Aur jab jaayein?
Mummy: Wahi, bas thoda zyada khush hoke.

title: Dadi Ka Zamana
text:
Chintu: Dadi, aapke time pe mobile tha?
Dadi: Nahi.
Chintu: Toh aap log time pass kaise karte the?
Dadi: Ek dusre se baat karke.
Chintu: Itna mushkil kaam?

title: Sota Hua Kaisa Lagta Hun
text:
Santa: Banta, tu mirror ke saamne aankh band karke kyun khada hai?
Banta: Dekh raha hun ki main sota hua kaisa lagta hun.

title: Fridge Ki Light
text:
Santa roz naye fridge ke saamne 10 minute baithta tha.
Banta: Yeh kya kar raha hai?
Santa: Dekh raha hun ki andar ki light kab band hoti hai.

title: Window Se Mail
text:
Banta: Santa, tu khidki se chitthi kyun phenk raha hai?
Santa: Computer wale bhaiya ne kaha tha, mail Windows se bhejna.

title: Seen Karke Reply
text:
Girlfriend: Tum mujhe kitna pyaar karte ho?
Boyfriend: Utna, jitna tum mujhe seen karke reply nahi karti.

title: 5 Minute Mein Ready
text:
Girlfriend: Main 5 minute mein ready ho jaungi.
Boyfriend (ek ghante baad): Maine web series ka poora season khatam kar diya.

title: Shirt Badli Hai
text:
Girlfriend: Tum badal gaye ho.
Boyfriend: Sirf shirt badli hai. Aadmi wahi hun.

title: Aakhri Fries
text: Pyaar ka sabse bada saboot: usne apni aakhri fries mujhe de di.

title: Crush Ka Hmm
text: Crush ka "hmm" reply bhi aisa lagta hai jaise poori poetry mil gayi ho.

title: Educational Channel
text:
Papa: TV band karo aur padhai karo.
Beta: Papa, yeh educational channel hai.
Papa: Achha? Toh remote mujhe do. Main bhi educate ho jaata hun.

title: Consistent Hun
text:
Mummy: Room kab saaf karoge?
Main: Kal.
Mummy: Kal bhi yahi bola tha.
Main: Dekha? Main kitna consistent hun.

title: Aap Jaisa Banunga
text:
Beta: Papa, main bada hoke bilkul aap jaisa banunga.
Papa: Achha? Kyun?
Beta: Taaki main bhi kisi ko padhai ka lecture de sakun.

title: Good News Bad News
text:
Papa: Result dikhao.
Beta: Papa, pehle good news: class mein sabse fast answer main likhta hun.
Papa: Aur bad news?
Beta: Sab galat hote hain.

title: Bhookh Nahi Hai
text:
Mummy: Kuch kha le.
Beta: Bhookh nahi hai.
Mummy: Toh thoda sa kha le.
(10 minute baad plate mein 6 rotiyaan.)

title: Maine Dhoondh Liya Toh
text:
Mummy: Agar maine dhoondh liya na, toh phir dekhna!
(Mummy ne 5 second mein dhoondh liya.)

title: 47 Photos
text:
Behen: Bhaiya, meri ek photo kheench do.
Bhai: Theek hai.
(47 photos baad)
Behen: Ek bhi achhi nahi aayi. Rehne do, tumse nahi hoga.

title: Bhai Ki Salary
text: Bhai ki salary aane se pehle hi behen ka shopping cart ready hota hai.

title: Main Dekh Leta Hun
text: Shaadi mein sabse zyada kaam "Main dekh leta hun" bolne waale uncle karte hain. Woh sirf dekhte hain.

title: Upasthiti Prarthniya
text:
Shaadi ka card: "Aapki upasthiti prarthniya hai."
Asli matlab: "Khaana hai, gift mat bhoolna."

title: Family Group
text: Family WhatsApp group: ek message, 40 thumbs-up, aur ek uncle ka "Kya matlab?"

title: Main So Gaya Tha
text: Seen: raat 2:14 baje. Reply: agle din. Excuse: "Main so gaya tha."

title: Neend Aur Wi-Fi
text: Neend aur Wi-Fi mein ek cheez same hai: dono tab jaate hain jab sabse zyada zaroorat hoti hai.

title: Diet Kal Se
text: Diet kal se. Aaj toh samose ne itne pyaar se dekha.

title: Balance Aur Attendance
text: Mera bank balance aur meri attendance, dono dekhke dar lagta hai.

title: Bas 5 Minute
text: Alarm 6 baje ka, uthna 8 baje, aur beech mein "bas 5 minute" saat baar.

title: Bandar Insaan Kyun Nahi
text: Agar insaan bandar se bane, toh baaki bandar ab tak insaan kyun nahi bane? Shayad unhe office jaana pasand nahi.

title: Woh Ek Din
text: Sab kehte hain, "Ek din sab theek ho jaayega." Woh ek din kaunsi date ko hai?

title: Aaj Monday Nahi Hai
text:
Q: Aaj itne khush kyun ho?
A: Aaj Monday nahi hai.
Q: Aaj Tuesday hai.
A: Haan, isiliye.

title: Weekend Plan
text:
Q: Weekend ka plan kya hai?
A: Plan banana. Phir cancel karna. Phir sona.

title: Gussa Kab Aata Hai
text:
Q: Tumhe gussa kab aata hai?
A: Jab biscuit chai mein dub ke toot jaata hai.

title: Mehmaan Wala Tone
text:
Mehmaan ke saamne mummy: "Beta, zara paani le aana."
Mehmaan ke jaane ke baad: "Ab kya aarti utaarun? Khud utho!"

title: Sharma Ji Ka Beta
text: Indian ghar mein koi bhi baat ho, ghoom-phir ke Sharma ji ke bete tak pahunch hi jaati hai.

title: Humare Zamane Mein
text: Dadi ka favourite dialogue: "Humare zamane mein..." aur phir 45 minute ka free entertainment.

title: PT Period
text: PT period: plan 40 minute ka, milta 10 minute, baaki 30 minute "line seedhi karo."

title: Kal Sunday Hai
text:
Pappu: Ma'am, main kal school nahi aa paunga.
Ma'am: Kyun?
Pappu: Kal Sunday hai, ma'am.

title: Kutte Ka Comment Section
text:
Billi: Tum har kisi ko dekhke bhaunkte kyun ho?
Kutta: Mere paas social media nahi hai. Yahi mera comment section hai.

title: Macchar Ka Audition
text: Macchar raat ko kaan mein aake aise gaata hai, jaise usse bhi kisi singing show ka audition dena ho.

title: Storage Full
text: Mera phone "Storage Full" dikhata hai, aur main bhi khaana khaane ke baad yahi feel karta hun.

title: Gym Ka Pasina
text: Gym join kiya. Pehle hi din itna pasina aaya... sirf fees sunke.

title: Fridge Mein Naya Answer
text: Raat ko baar-baar fridge kholna aisa hai, jaise 5 minute mein andar kuch naya aa gaya hoga.
